meta.project: SmartCoaster / HY928D 5 kg strain-gauge load cell

geometry.corner_holes: 4 x D3.1 at 28 x 28 mm pitch
geometry.features: through U-slot (2.5 mm wide), arch slot (R5.0-R8.2, 25-155 deg), two 12 x 2.5 mm vertical slots at x=+/-6.6, R2.5 notches
geometry.provisional: U-slot / arch / vertical-slot curves are reconstructed from the drawing and photos (params.json status=PROVISIONAL); dimensions are not supplier-confirmed.

material.name: 65Mn
material.yield: not specified by the project; supplier condition must be confirmed before a safety factor is quoted

assumptions.boundary_condition: ASSUMPTION A: all nodes within 2.2 mm of each corner-hole centre (radius 2.2 mm, full 1 mm thickness) are ENCASTRE (Ux=Uy=Uz=0). This is a simplification of the screw-clamp area, not a contact model.
assumptions.load: ASSUMPTION A: 49.05 N (5 kg) vertical -Z, distributed as consistent nodal forces on the top face z=1 mm inside r<=4.0 mm around the centre hole (annulus r=2.5-4.0 mm, area 30.59 mm2, mean pressure 1.60 MPa). 1 kg = 9.81 N case run separately.
assumptions.element: C3D10 quadratic tetrahedra; primary mesh h=0.28 mm (~3-4 elements through 1 mm thickness).
assumptions.solution: *STATIC, linear perturbation; no contact, no prestress, no geometric nonlinearity.

failed_meshes.note: valid mesh; solver ran out of SPOOLES capacity
valid mesh (no bad elements); solver SIGSEGV

linearity_1kg.method: same C3D10 h=0.30 mesh, separate 9.81 N solve (not scaled)
linearity_1kg.verdict: linear to <2e-7 relative; linear scaling is valid

C3D10_h035_vs_h030.note: center displacement is converged; the sharp-corner peak is not (singularity)

C3D4_h020_vs_h015.note: linear tets remain ~8% stiffer than the converged C3D10 result even at h=0.15

C3D10_h030_vs_C3D4_h015.note: element-type sensitivity: linear tets are too stiff for this bending-dominated plate

SIGSEGV (exit 139) after 13m56s during SPOOLES factorization; no result

convergence.verdict: C3D10 h=0.28 is converged for displacements (<0.1% vs h=0.30/0.35) and for the non-singular peak stress (~2%). Finer C3D10 meshes exceed the practical SPOOLES limit of this ccx build and were not used.

slot_vs_shallow.method: same C3D10 h=0.30 mesh; U-slot replaced by a 0.7 mm deep top pocket, 0.3 mm bottom web; all other features unchanged
slot_vs_shallow.caveat: the 0.3 mm web has only ~1 C3D10 element through its thickness at h=0.30; the shallow-cavity stiffness is therefore a preliminary estimate (likely within ~10%).

limitations: ENCASTRE over a 2.2 mm radius disk is a crude screw-clamp model; real screw/boss compliance, friction and base contact will change the reaction split and local stress.

The U-slot end at (+/-11.8, 9.6) is a sharp 90-degree corner in the reconstructed geometry. The 588 MPa peak there is a mesh-dependent singularity and must not be used as a design stress; the real part needs a rounded slot end.
The U-slot/arch/vertical-slot outlines are PROVISIONAL; the 468 MPa vertical-slot-end stress and the 1.72x stiffness ratio depend on these curves.

Linear elastic, small strain: at 0.34 mm centre travel on a 1 mm plate, geometric stiffening and contact with an overload stop are not modelled; the linear result is likely slightly conservative for displacement.
No strain-gauge/glue layer, no solder pads, no cable stiffness, no thermal residual stress.
The 1 kg case was verified on the h=0.30 mesh; the h=0.28 1 kg value is scaled (linear).
C3D10 h=0.25/0.20 runs failed inside SPOOLES (SIGSEGV) on this machine; h=0.28 is the finest successful C3D10 mesh. Convergence at h=0.28 is nevertheless <0.1% in centre displacement.
conclusions: 5 kg centre deflection: 0.343 mm (range 0.337-0.354 over the hole rim); 1 kg: 0.0687 mm. The linear ratio is 0.200000.
Max |U| = 0.369 mm at the tongue bottom notch (x=-2.5, y=-11.4).

The four corner reactions sum to 49.050 N (100.00% of the applied load), so the load path and BCs are consistent. The split is strongly asymmetric: the two screws at y=+14 carry 24.38 N each, the two at y=-14 only 0.142 N each (0.6%). The U-slot opens toward +y, so the bottom screws sit on a compliant tail. This is a model result and a key item to check in the assembly.

Absolute peak von Mises: 588 MPa at the sharp U-slot end corner (singular, mesh-dependent). The converged non-singular hot spot is 468 MPa at the R1.25 vertical-slot end (x=6.1, y=-5.9). Tongue-root nominal stress is 229 MPa, arch end 266 MPa, beam ligament 136 MPa, boss 163 MPa.

With the 0.5-0.6 mm assembly float gap, 0.343 mm centre travel uses 57-69% of the gap and exceeds the provisional FLOAT_GAP/2 acceptance limit (0.25-0.30 mm). Check overload-stop contact and part tolerances before committing.

Shallow 0.7 mm cavity: 1.72x stiffer (0.200 mm at 5 kg), tongue-root stress drops 229 -> 64 MPa, but the vertical-slot-end stress only drops 468 -> 447 MPa and the sensitivity falls by ~42%. It is not a free fix: the dominant slot-end concentration remains.
